author: Zintenka
body:
Decided to make the DTM and CTW versions separate.






Author:

Zintenka

Special Thanks To:

Alex AKA ScriptingLyfe for his build server and for voxel sniper!

Features:

  • 25v25
  • One chest of secret TNT for each side
  • One chest of secret spawn eggs for each side
  • Anyone on the opposite team who enters enemy spawn will suffer entity_explosion_damage (Damage done by TNT or a creeper); prevents spawn killing.
  • A DTM version 4 monuments
  • A CTW version 4 wools
  • 8 xp bottles for each kill
  • The center allows you to shoot fireballs at the other side at a velocity of 5.
  • Regeneration I for everyone
CTW Download

Imgur

CTW YML
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Changelog v1.0
  • Moved void gap closer as well as fix the orientation of the whole map
  • Added wither death sounds for each kill
  • 1.8 system of enchanting
  • Witherskull projectile with a velocity of 5
  • Increased damage resistance to 8 seconds after spawning
  • Got rid of cacti because of the potential heavy detriment to newer players
  • Fixed Wool YML and protective regions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Changelog v1.1
  • Fixing chests because chests lack items
  • Changing white wool to gray and blue to pink because the wools can be crafted... Damn you *Glares at a player*
  • Got rid of soul sand due to moderate amount of hassle when traveling around.
  • Other fixes and additions
